Partner with Us

Trainer Onboarding

Idatum Academy delivers training through a network of domain-certified practitioners. If you hold active credentials in any of our six training tracks, we'd like to hear from you.

What We Look for in a Trainer

Active Practitioner

You are currently working in the domain you train — not just teaching it. We don't engage career trainers without domain experience.

Certified & Current

You hold a recognized certification in your domain and keep it current. Expired credentials are not accepted.

Facilitation Skill

You can engage an adult professional audience — not just lecture. Case-based discussion and scenario facilitation are core to our delivery model.

India-Context Awareness

You understand how compliance frameworks apply in the Indian regulatory environment and can speak to local nuance.

The Onboarding Journey

From application to your first delivery assignment in as little as two weeks.

01

Application & Profile Review

1–2 business days

Submit your trainer application with credentials, certifications, and a sample of your delivery work. Our Curriculum team reviews your profile against Idatum's practitioner standards.

Credentials & certification verificationSubject-matter expertise assessmentSample content or delivery review
02

Orientation Session

Half-day (virtual)

A structured orientation covering Idatum Academy's pedagogical standards, delivery protocols, learner engagement expectations, and quality benchmarks.

Academy learning philosophyDelivery standards & expectationsLMS and tooling walkthrough
03

Content Familiarisation

2–3 days self-paced

Access to the full course library in your domain(s). Trainers review participant workbooks, facilitator guides, slide decks, and case study packs before delivery.

Facilitator guide reviewCase study and scenario bank accessAssessment instrument walkthrough
04

Observed Trial Delivery

1 session

Deliver a live 90-minute module segment with an Idatum Curriculum Lead observing. Structured feedback is provided using our trainer evaluation rubric.

Live delivery with curriculum observerReal-time notes and structured debriefEvaluation against Idatum rubric
05

Certification & Activation

Within 48 hours of trial

Upon successful trial delivery, you receive your Idatum Certified Trainer designation, access to the trainer portal, and your first delivery assignment.

Idatum Certified Trainer credentialTrainer portal accessFirst assignment scheduling

Track-Specific Requirements

Minimum credential requirements vary by training track. All tracks require active practitioner status.

POSH

IC Member experience or legal background in employment law

ISMS

ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or CISM certification

SOC 2

Active SOC 2 audit or implementation experience

ISO

ISO Lead Auditor certification in relevant standard

ITGC

CISA or equivalent IT audit qualification

Audit

IIA membership and minimum 5 years audit experience

Ready to Deliver for Idatum Academy?

Send us your credentials and a brief note about your experience. We'll review and respond within two business days.
